item.title: A cache miss happens when a model has to re-read (and re-charge you for) text it had already
item.author: @pidotdev
item.description:
A cache miss happens when a model has to re-read (and re-charge you for) text it had already processed before.

This can be caused by:
 - switching models
 - idling past 5mins
- editing earlier threads

Pi can notify you when this happens and how much it costs!

item.title: Run /settings and set ‘cache miss notices’ to True. Follow the cache miss notice with the /sessions command
item.author: @pidotdev
item.description:
Run /settings and set ‘cache miss notices’ to True.

Follow the cache miss notice with the /sessions command for an even more detailed report!

item.title: I love how many people are attaching to the "half-bounch" startup time metric. I used to do paid
item.author: @mitchellh
